directive: 通知の発生状況と話者を踏まえ、必要な情報を簡潔に伝える。変数を保つ。

entries.JA_new: 原因不明のエラー。接続を中断しました……

entries.EN: Critical error. Out of memory. System will now reboot...
entries.JA_current: Critical error. Out of memory. System will now reboot...
entries.JA_new: 致命的なエラー。メモリ不足です。システムを再起動します……

entries.EN: Critical error. Reconnecting to the server...
entries.JA_current: Critical error. Reconnecting to the server...
entries.JA_new: 致命的なエラー。サーバーに再接続しています……

entries.EN: Yury has kicked the bucket again! Good omen!
entries.JA_current: Yury has kicked the bucket again! Good omen!
entries.JA_new: ユーリーがまた死んだ！　縁起がいいぞ！

entries.EN: Semetskiy got choked! The raid is sure to be generous!
entries.JA_current: Semetskiy got choked! The raid is sure to be generous!
entries.JA_new: セメツキーが首を絞められた！　今回は大当たり間違いなしだ！

entries.EN: Too often lately... Semetskiy, I mean... Is that a warning, I wonder?
entries.JA_current: Too often lately... Semetskiy, I mean... Is that a warning, I wonder?
entries.JA_new: 最近、セメツキーが死にすぎだ……何かの警告なのか？

entries.EN: Well... I'm organizing a raid into the Zone. Semetskiy died, so luck will be with us.
entries.JA_current: Well... I'm organizing a raid into the Zone. Semetskiy died, so luck will be with us.
entries.JA_new: よし……ゾーンに遠征隊を出す。セメツキーが死んだ、今度は運が向いてるぞ。

entries.EN: Is it true that the death of Semetskiy notification on the PDA is a good omen?
entries.JA_current: Is it true that the death of Semetskiy notification on the PDA is a good omen?
entries.JA_new: セメツキーの死亡通知がPDAに届くと縁起がいいって、本当か？

entries.EN: Hey! Quit drinking and let's go for artifacts! Who's with me?
entries.JA_current: Hey! Quit drinking and let's go for artifacts! Who's with me?
entries.JA_new: おい！　飲んでる場合か、アーティファクトを探しに行くぞ！　誰か来るか？
ユーリー・セメツキー

entries.EN: Where can we take cover here? Help!
entries.JA_current: Where can we take cover here? Help!
entries.JA_new: ここで身を隠せる場所はないか？　助けてくれ！

entries.EN: Folks, please! Where's the closest shelter? I'm a newbie here.
entries.JA_current: Folks, please! Where's the closest shelter? I'm a newbie here.
entries.JA_new: みんな、頼む！　一番近い避難場所はどこだ？　ここは初めてなんだ。

entries.EN: Fucking shit! im out of time! Where can I take cover nearby?
entries.JA_current: Fucking shit! im out of time! Where can I take cover nearby?
entries.JA_new: くそっ、時間がない！　近くに隠れられる場所はどこだ？

entries.EN: Damn! DAMN! DAMN!!! What will we do now?!
entries.JA_current: Damn! DAMN! DAMN!!! What will we do now?!
entries.JA_new: くそっ！　くそっ！　くそっ！　これからどうすりゃいいんだ？！

entries.EN: Detached communication line lost. Unable to continue operation in the area. Requesting evac.
entries.JA_current: Detached communication line lost. Unable to continue operation in the area. Requesting evac.
entries.JA_new: 別働隊との通信が途絶。現地での作戦続行は不可能。撤収を要請する。

entries.EN: Get us outta here! Urgently! The communication line is almost down!
entries.JA_current: Get us outta here! Urgently! The communication line is almost down!
entries.JA_new: ここから出してくれ！　急げ！　通信回線が切れかけてる！

entries.EN: Requesting immediate evacuation. Electronic equipment rendered unusable due to major fault.
entries.JA_current: Requesting immediate evacuation. Electronic equipment rendered unusable due to major fault.
entries.JA_new: 直ちに撤収を要請する。重大な故障で電子機器が使用不能。
撤収させてくれ！　急げ！

entries.EN: Unable to find cover. The equipment is getting damaged. Urgent evacuation required!
entries.JA_current: Unable to find cover. The equipment is getting damaged. Urgent evacuation required!
entries.JA_new: 避難場所が見つからない。装備が損傷している。至急撤収が必要だ！

entries.EN: No shelter in the specified area! Get us out of here quickly!
entries.JA_current: No shelter in the specified area! Get us out of here quickly!
entries.JA_new: 指定された区域に避難場所がない！　すぐにここから出してくれ！

entries.EN: HQ! Damn! Evacuate us urgently! The detached communication line is down already!
entries.JA_current: HQ! Damn! Evacuate us urgently! The detached communication line is down already!
entries.JA_new: 司令部、くそっ！　至急撤収させてくれ！　別働隊との通信はもう切れてる！

entries.EN: Mayday! Mayday! Requesting immediate evacuation! Mission failed! Repeat: mission failed!
entries.JA_current: Mayday! Mayday! Requesting immediate evacuation! Mission failed! Repeat: mission failed!
entries.JA_new: メーデー！　メーデー！　至急撤収を要請する！　任務失敗！　繰り返す、任務失敗！

entries.EN: Get us out of here! Make it quick! The equipment is going down! Awaiting for transport!
entries.JA_current: Get us out of here! Make it quick! The equipment is going down! Awaiting for transport!
entries.JA_new: ここから出してくれ！　急いでくれ！　装備が駄目になりそうだ！　輸送を待っている！

entries.EN: The area has to be abandoned - no shelter present. Requesting transport for evacuation!
entries.JA_current: The area has to be abandoned - no shelter present. Requesting transport for evacuation!
entries.JA_new: この区域を放棄する。避難場所がない。撤収用の輸送手段を要請する！

entries.EN: Shit! HQ! What moron planned an operation just before the Blowout?! Get us out! Quick!
entries.JA_current: Shit! HQ! What moron planned an operation just before the Blowout?! Get us out! Quick!
entries.JA_new: くそっ、司令部！　光熱放射の直前に作戦を組んだ馬鹿は誰だ？！　すぐ撤収させろ！

entries.EN: No shelter nearby. The outfit is insufficient to remain in field. Get us out urgently!
entries.JA_current: No shelter nearby. The outfit is insufficient to remain in field. Get us out urgently!
entries.JA_new: 近くに避難場所がない。この装備では野外に留まれない。至急撤収させてくれ！

entries.EN: , don't panic. There's a place to take cover for you. Here are the coordinates...
entries.JA_current: , don't panic. There's a place to take cover for you. Here are the coordinates...
entries.JA_new: 、慌てるな。隠れられる場所がある。座標を送る……

entries.EN: ! Calm down! There's a shelter nearby. Follow the coordinates...
entries.JA_current: ! Calm down! There's a shelter nearby. Follow the coordinates...
entries.JA_new: ！　落ち着け！　近くに避難場所がある。座標を確認しろ……

entries.EN: , stay calm. If you are a good runner - you'll make it to shelter. Here are the coordinates...
entries.JA_current: , stay calm. If you are a good runner - you'll make it to shelter. Here are the coordinates...
entries.JA_new: 、落ち着け。足が速けりゃ避難場所まで間に合う。座標を送る……

entries.EN: , look, send me your coordinates. So that I know where I can loot your body. Ha-ha-ha!
entries.JA_current: , look, send me your coordinates. So that I know where I can loot your body. Ha-ha-ha!
entries.JA_new: 、いいか、座標を送れ。お前の死体から何を漁れるか分かるようにな。ははは！

entries.EN: , sorry, I cannot help you. Godspeed.
entries.JA_current: , sorry, I cannot help you. Godspeed.
entries.JA_new: 、悪いが助けには行けない。幸運を祈る。

entries.EN: don't panic! The transport is under way. Keep waiting.
entries.JA_current: don't panic! The transport is under way. Keep waiting.
entries.JA_new: 慌てるな！　輸送車両が向かっている。そこで待て。

entries.EN: stay calm! The car is out for you. Proceed towards it.
entries.JA_current: stay calm! The car is out for you. Proceed towards it.
entries.JA_new: 落ち着け！　車両が迎えに出た。そっちへ向かえ。

entries.EN: Evac is enroute. Proceed to the evacuation point.
entries.JA_current: Evac is enroute. Proceed to the evacuation point.
entries.JA_new: 避難車両が向かっている。避難地点へ向かえ。

entries.EN: the transport will be at the rv point in two minutes. Double time.
entries.JA_current: the transport will be at the rv point in two minutes. Double time.
entries.JA_new: 車両は集合地点に2分で着く。急げ。

entries.EN: proceed to the evacuation point quickly! You'll be picked up there in a couple of minutes.
entries.JA_current: proceed to the evacuation point quickly! You'll be picked up there in a couple of minutes.
entries.JA_new: 急いで避難地点へ向かえ！　2、3分で迎えが来る。

entries.EN: sorry, but there's nobody to help you. Use your own discretion. May the Zone take mercy on you...
entries.JA_current: sorry, but there's nobody to help you. Use your own discretion. May the Zone take mercy on you...
entries.JA_new: 悪いが、助けに行ける者はいない。自分で判断してくれ。ゾーンの慈悲にすがれ……

entries.EN: sorry, there will be no evacuation. The transport has been destroyed. God help you...
entries.JA_current: sorry, there will be no evacuation. The transport has been destroyed. God help you...
entries.JA_new: 悪いが、避難は中止だ。輸送機が破壊された。神のご加護を……
